newsitem.title: POLAND: Foreigners to up stake in Polish treasuries in '97.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners to up stake in Polish treasuries in '97.

text.p: The Polish finance ministry forecast that foreign investors' holdings of zloty-denominated debt instruments will rise to 4.32 billion zlotys at the end of 1997 from a projected 2.95 billion at the end of this year.
It said in its 1997 budget draft that foreigners will hold two percent of all of zloty-denominated treasuries at the end of next year, up from 1.5 percent this year.
